caption:
Every afternoon at a quarter past three, a little girl crosses Lorna Webb’s road.

A red jumper. A felt fox on her bag. A different woman waiting for her on the far side every day.

Then the school tells Lorna they have no such pupil.

Cross When Clear, my new psychological thriller, is coming this week. 🖤

slides.heading: The lollipop lady
slides.body:
For eleven years Lorna Webb has stood outside St Anne’s Primary in Gloucester.

She knows every child, every parent, and every car that idles where it shouldn’t.

slides.heading: The girl
slides.body:
A red jumper. A felt fox on her bag.

A different woman meets her on the far side every day. None of them ever looks at the school.
